Source: Driver and Vehicle Standards Agency (DVSA), Driving test and theory test data: cars, https://www.gov.uk/government/statistical-data-sets/driving-test-and-theory-test-data-cars.
method: The waits are the Driver and Vehicle Standards Agency (DVSA) figures for car practical driving tests, as DVSA publishes them each month: table DRT122F by test centre and table DRT121G by region. medianWaitWeeks is DVSA's median wait in weeks; the share columns are DVSA's percentages of tests taken within 7 weeks, between 7 and 14 weeks, between 14 and 21 weeks and after more than 21 weeks. The only arithmetic here is rank and change: rank orders the open centres that have a median wait in a month, longest wait first, and centres with the same median share a rank; change3m, change6m and change12m are the month's median wait minus the same centre's (or region's) median wait 3, 6 and 12 months earlier, in weeks to two decimal places, and are blank when either month has no figure. DVSA's shorthand ([n] no tests conducted, [r] redacted because of 10 or fewer, [x] not available, [z] not applicable, [rv] revised, [c] confidential, and N/A) is kept in suppressed and nothing is filled in. A centre DVSA shows as closed has centreStatus closed and no rank; a centre DVSA marks closed in some months and open in others keeps one key, and changes are not adjusted for this. provisional is true for months DVSA publishes as provisional (data since April 2025, at the date of this release). This page is not published by DVSA and carries no endorsement from it. It is not a booking tool: it cannot be used to find or book a test.
title: Driving test waits in Great Britain, by region
